leadText: The Key to Me is the English ending theme for Pikachu, What's This Key?. It is included on the Pokémon Movie Music Collection album.
plainText:
The Key to Me is the English ending theme for Pikachu, What's This Key?. It is included on the Pokémon Movie Music Collection album.

==Lyrics==
 Show me the key to you
I'll show you the key to me
We're gonna be best friends
Join me
On a journey that never ends
What do you like to do?
Who do you want to be?
Show me the key to you
I'll show you...I'll show you the key to me

We jump around 'n' round 'n' round 'n' round
We're flyin' round 'n' round and up and down
We jump around 'n' round 'n' round 'n' round
We're flyin' round 'n' round and up and down

Show me the key to you
I'll show you the key to me
Behind every door
Are new worlds
New places to explore
Where do you want to go?
What do you want to see?
Show me the key to you
I'll show you...I'll show you the key to me

We're in the clouds clouds clouds clouds
We're singin' loud 'n' loud 'n' loud 'n' loud
We jump around 'n' round 'n' round 'n' round
We jump around 'n' round and up and down
We jump around 'n' round 'n' round 'n' round
We're bouncin' round 'n' round and up and down
We jump around 'n' round 'n' round 'n' round
We're bouncin' round 'n' round and up and down 

==Credits==
Composed by Ed Goldfarb
Music editing and assistance: Akhil Gopal
Words and Music by Ed Goldfarb
Performed by Dani Marcus
Arranged and produced by Ed Goldfarb
Mixed by Jeff Saltzman
